tagline: The Pearl of the Pacific — a constant daily panga crossing to Stone Island.
summary: Mazatlán is a large Pacific resort and port city with the longest boardwalk in Latin America. Its everyday waterborne corridor is the short crossing from the downtown embarcadero to Isla de la Piedra (Stone Island) — a genuine daily-use panga run for residents and visitors alike, not just a tour. It's a solid display market with a clear signature crossing.

navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) is optional here; the core network is well inside Pioneer II all-electric range.

competitive_landscape: Local pangas run the crossing continuously; no premium tier exists. The land alternative is a long road detour around the estuary.
seasonality: Pacific hurricane season (Jun–Nov); winter is peak cruise season. The estuary crossing is sheltered.
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API Mazatlán, Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR).
